name: io.github.gablooge/lawang-onboard
title: Lawang Onboard
description: Permission-aware onboarding MCP server: answers about a codebase, filtered by the caller's role.

packageArguments.description: Run over stdio instead of HTTP

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The token this client uses. Set it to the same value as one of the role tokens below; that role decides what you see.

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_TOKEN_CONTRACTOR
environmentVariables.description: Token for the contractor role (any secret you choose)

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_TOKEN_EMPLOYEE
environmentVariables.description: Token for the employee role (any secret you choose)

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_TOKEN_MAINTAINER
environmentVariables.description: Token for the maintainer role (any secret you choose)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for your role (maintainer, employee or contractor). Ask the server operator for one.

onboard_token.description: Role token issued by the server operator
